industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. Preferred Shares (BEP.PR.M)
summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. runs a large publicly traded platform for renewable power. Its portfolio includes hydroelectric, wind and solar facilities in North America, South America, Europe and Asia. It sells the electricity it produces into wholesale markets and through long-term contracts with utilities and big corporate buyers.
